categories.label: Practical Experience
categories.description: internships, first roles, freelance or volunteer work where code reached real users. Any production exposure counts; described outcomes count more.

categories.label: Projects & Portfolio
categories.description: personal, academic or research projects that show real engineering: non-trivial scope, working code that can be inspected or run, and clear explanation of what was built and why.

categories.label: Technical Foundations
categories.description: command of at least one language and framework, plus fundamentals: data structures, databases, APIs, version control, testing and basic deployment.

categories.label: Learning & Initiative
categories.description: curiosity and drive beyond the job description: open source, research, writing, certifications, hackathons, communities, or teaching others.

bonus_description: published research or technical writing, contributions to other people's open source projects, relevant certifications, hackathon results, side projects with real users, evidence of shipping fast in a first role.
